200.description: The purchase order, its acknowledgement, labels and shipment.

schema.description:
The network's instruction to one vendor node to ship one shipment group in
full by `requiredShipBy`. Carries no ship-to PII.

requiredShipBy.description: The pickup cutoff the order must be ready for (the fleet calls it the CPT).

ackBy.description: min(issuedAt + vendor ackWindow, requiredShipBy - node handlingTime).

listingId.description: The network's listing (one catalogue item offered from one node).

packaging.description: The active packaging levels of the listing's catalogue item, from the network's catalogue (empty when none was declared).

childGtin.description: The GTIN of the next lower level; absent for EACH.

unitsPerPack.description: Eaches in one unit of this level (1 for EACH).

acknowledgement.description: Absent until the vendor's acknowledgement transaction succeeds.

items.description: A shipping label reference. Never carries the ship-to address.
items.title: Label

labels.description: The labels issued so far; `[]` when none.

trackingNumbers.description: The tracking numbers confirmed shipped; `[]` until the shipment confirmation succeeds.

schema.title: PurchaseOrder

404.description:
The resource does not exist (`not-found`), or it belongs to another vendor
(`ErrNodeNotOwnedByVendor`, problem type `node-not-owned-by-vendor`, 404 so a vendor cannot probe another vendor's nodes).

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `ack-window-closed`.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before the next call.

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared `not-found`, `illegal-transition`, `concurrent-update` and `validation-failed`, or one slug per `Err...` name of this context, for example `ack-window-closed`.
